# Goal of delivering the program

With the Train-the-Trainer program, we aim to:

- **Encourage** researchers and educators at LMU familiar with open research to **disseminate their open research knowledge and skills** through **teaching** (standalone open research modules, or individual workshops/seminars.)
- **Familiarize** a broad audience across the LMU with open research principles and the relevance for their own work, e.g., Master students, PhDs, PostDocs, PIs, research support staff.

## General delivery procedure

::: {style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| **When**      | **What**                                            | **Actions to be taken**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | **Notes**                                                                                                                                          |

| Pre workshop  | Advertising                                         | Email administrators of graduate programs to add event adverts to newsletters, add event adverts to Infodienst mailing list, share workshop application link on OSC social media accounts (LinkedIn, BlueSky)                                                                                                               | Ensure selection criteria for attendance and certificates and any post-workshop sessions are clearly communicated on application form.             |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Pre workshop  | Pre-workshop survey                                 | Generate survey using [formR](https://formr.org/) to gain insights into participants prior knowledge, expectations and confidence levels (questions you could include: What are you hoping to get out of the workshop? What is a challenge you are dealing with at the moment?)                                             | See [OSC events](https://lmu-osc.github.io/manual/osc-events/) for more details for the logistical side of organising events                       |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Pre workshop  | Organizers/instructors liaise with facilitators     | Within event planning document for organizers add information about how facilitators can support instructors during the workshop                                                                                                                                                                                            | Important things to consider: managing hybrid workshop, handling group activities, technical facilitation (e.g. a Git workshop)                    |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Delivery      | Delivery of training material                       | At the start of workshop begin with orientation, logistics and sharing annonymized results of pre-workshop survey.                                                                                                                                                                                                          | Clearly outline learning goals, where to find training materials and introduce facilitators.                                                       |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Post workshop | Post-workshop survey                                | Use [formR survey](https://surveys.osc.lmu.de/template-workshop-feedback/) based on the Google Doc [template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1bOJMFQGDvXsULr8sb7aZ2Sn37lrIV7liAY7KummEfms/edit?usp=sharing) analysed with our template quarto to docx [report](https://github.com/MalikaIhle/ttt-workshop-feedback) | Important questions to include pre and post ability (workshop) or understanding (lecture) + highlights + suggestions for improvement.              |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Post workshop | Follow up sessions (for summer school participants) | Create a central Google Doc for participants to use to mark attendance, share notes, resources                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Sending participants a calendar invite with follow up sessions tends to increase attendance rates. Ensure central document is not shared publicly. |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Post workshop | Offboarding                                         | Send out an email with offboarding information                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | See OSC events wrap up and feedback [page](https://lmu-osc.github.io/manual/osc-events/wrapup-feedback.html)                                       |
+---------------+-----------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
:::

An overview of possible delivery options and formats for the train-the-trainer program. *Note that these were pulled from brainstorming discussions and are not fully developed ideas.*

::: {style="font-size: 0.8em;"}
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| **What**                                                   | **Target audience**                            | **Timeframe** | **Concept/notes**                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | **Feasability**                    |
+:===========================================================+:===============================================+:==============+::===================================+
| Consultation and follow-up on open research teaching plans | Track 2 participants from LMU (PhDs, PostDocs) | variable      | Follow-up, consult and support Track 2 LMU participants to deliver their workshop, possibly co-teach or support                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | Have trainers teach parts of SWoP? |
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Standalone train-the-trainer course                        | Track 1 participants from LMU (PhDs, PostDocs) | 2 days        | Two-day course following the program of Track 2 of the [Open Science Summer School 2026](https://lmu-osc.github.io/Open-Science-Summer-School-2026/track2-program.html)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |                                    |
|                                                            |                                                |               |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |                                    |
|                                                            |                                                |               | Ideally should include some ice-breaker/team building at the start                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |                                    |
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Standalone train-the-trainer course                        | SWoP participants (PhDs, PostDocs)             | 1 day         | Modified program of Track 2 of the [Open Science Summer School 2026](https://lmu-osc.github.io/Open-Science-Summer-School-2026/track2-program.html)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Attach to SWoP sessions            |
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Standalone train-the-trainer course                        | Principal investigators from LMU               | 1 day         | Asychronous introductory lectures and modified program of Track 2 of the [Open Science Summer School 2026](https://lmu-osc.github.io/Open-Science-Summer-School-2026/track2-program.html) to convey basic teaching and leadership skills for OS teaching                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |                                    |
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Introduction to Open Research                              | Principal investigators from LMU               | 2 - 4 hours   | Modified versions of the introductory and solution slides (watch online first). No hands-on experience required; aim is to improve their conceptual understanding, why it is important, and to reduce misconceptions and myths. (cf. devil’s advocate game in prereg; “common myths” to debunk). Potential format: They should watch the lecture at least once (could be done asynchronously as a video), then have a 2h session which (a) points towards next steps (in-depth material, what comes next) and (b) interactively (in person?) work on misconceptions (gamification)                                                                            |                                    |
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
| Monthly themed workshop                                    | Late-stage PhDs, Post Docs from LMU            | 2 hours       | A targeted one off instructor training workshop for learners who have expertise in a particular Open Science practice (e.g. preregistration, R, Quarto, Git, power analysis and simulations) wishing to improve their pedagogy skills and apply it to a specific practice. Call for participants should be explicit that they should have medium-to-high competency in the Open Science topic for the practice they wish to teach. Workshops would occur on a monthly basis focusing on a particular topic. During workshop participants would be signposted to the OSC's existing materials (e.g. self-paced tutorial and/or training materials for novices) |                                    |
+------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
:::

### Standalone course: Outline

Designed for PhDs, PostDocs, PIs etc. with experience in Open Research over a two-day period or four mornings/afternoons; modelled after [Open Science Summer School 2026](https://lmu-osc.github.io/Open-Science-Summer-School-2026/track2-program.html). Facilitators are highly recommended (1-2), especially for hybrid sessions. Facilitators can assist main instructor with managing small group discussions, managing technical elements of sessions (e.g. sharing activity links, trouble shooting, creating virtual breakout rooms).
